# AstryxRadioList { #anylumino.AstryxRadioList }

```python
AstryxRadioList(items, value, *, label, **props)
```

Render a single-choice Astryx radio list.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Default    |
|---------|-----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| items   | Iterable\[Any\] | Item records used by generated child components or static search sources.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | _required_ |
| value   | str             | Synchronized component value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | _required_ |
| label   | str             | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | _required_ |
| **props | Any             | JSON-safe RadioList props. Useful keys: isLabelHidden, description, orientation, isDisabled, isRequired, isOptional, status, size, labelTooltip, className, and style. anylumino generates radio items from items and manages value/onChange synchronization. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/RadioList>. | `{}`       |
